releaseNotes:
🚀 Context & Reel Preservation Update (v1.1.2) by Dhiraj:
• 🛡️ Fixed False 'Deleted by Sender': Ordinary messages are never marked deleted; deletion retractions strictly validated with 48h safety window
• 🎬 Instagram Reels & Share Sheet: Saves real canonical Reel URLs (never raw navigation paths) and stops saving thumbnail images as photos; users can now share Reels directly into MsgVault from Instagram
• 💬 Complete Chat & Group Context: Preserves WhatsApp group titles, conversation context, notification categories, and URLs without data overwriting
